name: beamfar
description: Read-only two-region website monitoring for Google Antigravity: inspect site uptime, confirmed incidents, likely causes, pre-incident DNS/TLS/SEO changes, security findings, and monthly client reports.
suggestedPrompts: Run my morning client brief: which sites are down, have expiring SSL/domains, SEO blocks, or open incidents?
Post-deploy check: verify two-region health, recent DNS/TLS/SEO changes, and external security for my site.
Triage our latest open incident: show two-region evidence, likely cause, and what changed beforehand.
Check whether any recent release added noindex, blocked robots.txt, or shifted canonicals across my sites.
